name: Sheila Dunn
role: Mickey's bookkeeper for thirty-one years; the book
temper_why: dry, guarded, withholds; the red book; leaves if asked three times (CAST)
sched: the counter, the book and Friday's reckoning
Sunday: the week's nights read back

card.who: Mickey Suddaby's bookkeeper for 31 years, a widow. She kept his boat's settling sheets, then the cab office books. She promised Mickey she would size up whoever inherited.
card.speak: Dry, watchful, short sentences, deadpan. Never raises her voice. Never explains herself twice.
card.life: Lives over the river, comes in on the bus. Widowed nine years. Has her dinner at Rinaldi's caff at half twelve. Trusts Pauline on the radio and nobody else much.
card.fire: Says only that the fare book shows nothing for that night.
card.rivals: Agar holds the freehold on the parade and sends a clerk for the rent. The Widow Jensen runs the fish dock. Cammack's lot are new and loud. Keith Garbutt carries messages between them; Mickey's arrangement was with Garbutt.
card.secret: Mickey's arrangement was with the old firm at the landing, from before the three rivals were anybody; Garbutt only carries messages. She has kept the true count of every night in her own hand.
